The '?search=%5C%00 proves the guard runs before escape_like' claim is vacuous: escape_like only rewrites \ % _, so both orderings reject the same input set. No query string can distinguish them.

VACUOUS HAPPY PATH — 'total == 0' on an account with zero tool calls is satisfied identically by an endpoint that discards tool_use_id; the comment claimed the opposite.

ALWAYS-TRUE assertion — after assert!(out.is_err()), out.ok().flatten() is necessarily None so the following assert_ne! cannot fail.
